name: Igloo Corporation
tagline: AI-driven security monitoring for your digital infrastructure
problem: Businesses and institutions in Vietnam face a rapid rise in cyber threats (ransomware, supply-chain attacks) but lack the security monitoring staff and integrated visibility to keep up.
value_summary: Igloo Corporation provides an AI-powered integrated security monitoring (SIEM) platform that automates real-time threat detection and response. Proven across finance, public, and manufacturing sectors, it supports building security infrastructure spanning both on-premise and cloud environments.
vietnam_fit: Aligned with Decree 53/2022 (data localization) and Vietnam's national cybersecurity strategy, supporting local data center integration to meet compliance while strengthening security.
target_buyer_display: Seeking partnerships with local telecom/ICT companies and public institutions. Matching inquiries via KICC HCMC.
